integrity: Exact group-theoretic proof with separately identified published combinatorial input; finite tests are not claimed to establish the infinite theorem.
scientific_limitations: For smooth flex-marked plane cubics over finite fields whose rational point count is divisible by three only; excess-one case is the asserted new application. Near-transversal and zero-sum partition theorems are prior inputs, not novel. Unindexed coincident application remains a priority risk.
title: A sharp one-line obstruction for covering finite-field elliptic cubics with one rational involution
